title: Responder a una queja de cliente por un pedido incompleto
scenario: Gestionar una queja de cliente en una tienda online

content.studentInstructions: Lee el email de queja y la respuesta del departamento de atención al cliente. Después responde a las preguntas y mejora dos frases para que suenen más profesionales.
content.teacherNotes: Recurso para trabajar tono profesional, disculpas, soluciones y vocabulario de comercio electrónico.

sections.title: Customer complaint
sections.body: Hello, I received my order this morning, but one item is missing. I ordered two wireless keyboards and a laptop stand, but the laptop stand was not in the box. I need it for a presentation next Monday. Can you solve this as soon as possible?
tasks: Find the deadline mentioned by the customer.
Underline two phrases that show urgency.

sections.title: Customer service reply
sections.body: Dear Ms Carter, thank you for contacting us. We are sorry for the inconvenience. We have checked your order and the laptop stand was not included due to a warehouse error. We will send it today by express delivery at no extra cost. You will receive a tracking number this afternoon.

answerKey: The customer needs it before next Monday.
Useful professional phrases: We are sorry for the inconvenience; at no extra cost; tracking number.
